fee_notes: Standard single-unit Initial Franchise Fee is $42,500 for new franchisees. Discounts available for veterans ($38,250), existing franchisees ($37,500), and existing franchisees who are also veterans ($33,750). Area Development Agreement pricing differs: 3 locations range from $74,250–$97,500 total; 5 locations range from $112,500–$150,000 total; each additional location adds $22,500–$30,000. During 2023, actual Initial Franchise Fees received ranged from $27,000 to $42,500. All fees are non-refundable and due in full at signing.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for a single Waxing Studio is $42,500. However, we offer other pricing options for veterans, existing franchisees who are not in default under their existing Franchise Agreement(s) with us, and for prospects signing an Area Development Agreement to operate multiple franchises... During 2023, we received Initial Franchise Fees ranging from $27,000 to $42,500.
